messages.subject: [Roxygen-devel] Unwanted R Documentation
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am trying to find a way to not produce a man file for a given function
when I roxygenize my files.  I am wondering about this because these
functions are documented as an alias in other functions.

I have also had trouble downloaded the latest version from the R-Forge
website.

Any help would be appreciated.

Best,
Barret Schloerke

messages.subject: [Roxygen-devel] Unwanted R Documentation
messages.body_plain:
Hi Barret,
 
This seems to be one of the most-demanded features of Roxygen. Unless there's some update I'm not aware of, it is not currently possible, but it is planned for future releases using tag @nord. 
 
In the meantime, I have a handmade R script that removes the unwanted files (probably it's even possible to have this automatically done on every package build using a makefile, but never had the time to try it)
 
Best,
 
Enrique

Any help would be appreciated.

Best,

messages.subject: [Roxygen-devel] Roxygenize should take list of doclets
messages.subject_clean: [Roxygen-devel] Roxygenize should take list of doclets
messages.body_plain:
It would be really nice if roxygenize() took a list of roclets to
create.  Then you could do something like:

roclets <- c("Rd", "namespace", "collate", "callgraph")
makers <- match.fun(paste("make.", roclets, ".roclet", sep = ""))
for (maker in makers) make(package.dir)

This would require that all roclets are parameterised in terms of the
package directory, but I think this would be a good thing, and not too
much work.  I could probably provide a patch, if you were interested.

Hadley

-- 
http://had.co.nz/

messages.subject: [Roxygen-devel] A few roxygen improvements
messages.body_plain:
Patches attached:

 1.  Don't switch working directories in collate.R

 2.  Use lapply instead of map, and eliminate some do.calls - this
decreases the stack depth and makes profiling much easier

 3.  Currently roxygen performs an exhaustive walk of function
expressions when it really only needs to get the assignee and formals.
 This patch is a quick (hacky) way to get just the info needed, and
speeds roxygen up 3 fold.

Hadley

--
